summary: Frontend-only verification of the reviews + FAQ + SEO/AEO iteration on Modernstäd.se. All 7 requested feature groups verified via Playwright against the public URL (Vite + TS on port 3000). No functional regressions observed.

verified_behaviour.reviews_section: 9/9 review cards render (r1..r9), stars visible per card, average badge shows 4,8 baserat på 9 omdömen, demo disclaimer note visible via data-testid=reviews-demo-note.
verified_behaviour.faq_accordion: faq-section renders 8 items. faq-answer-0 open by default. Clicking faq-toggle-2 opens faq-answer-2; clicking again collapses it (count goes 1 -> 0).
verified_behaviour.seo_meta_per_route: document.title, meta description, canonical, og:url and twitter:title/description all update between /, /privat, /foretag. Titles observed: 'Städning i Malmö – Hemstädning med RUT | Modernstäd.se' (home), 'Hemstädning Malmö med RUT-avdrag från 226 kr/tim | Modernstäd.se' (privat), 'Kontorsstädning & företagsstädning i Malmö | Modernstäd.se' (foretag). Canonicals and og:url match each route.
verified_behaviour.structured_data_home: 3 JSON-LD blocks parse cleanly: CleaningService, WebSite, FAQPage. CleaningService fields verified: taxID=559391-4392, telephone=+46736200637, email=arbazshah11@gmail.com.
verified_behaviour.structured_data_privat_foretag: Both /privat and /foretag show 4 JSON-LD blocks: static CleaningService + WebSite (from index.html) plus injected Service + BreadcrumbList. All parse-able.
verified_behaviour.cleanup_on_navigation: Navigating back to / removes previous route's Service/BreadcrumbList and re-injects FAQPage. Home ends with exactly [CleaningService, WebSite, FAQPage] (no stale duplicates).
verified_behaviour.robots_txt: GET /robots.txt returns 200 and includes Sitemap plus Allow rules for GPTBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot (also OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, Google-Extended, Bingbot).
verified_behaviour.sitemap_xml: GET /sitemap.xml returns 200 with entries for /, /privat, /foretag (valid XML urlset).
verified_behaviour.regression_wizard_and_ai: /privat renders booking-flow-privat wizard and ai-agent-toggle. Opening AI panel loads Stella prisagent with intro copy and input; hero + PRIVAT/FÖRETAG nav still functional. No new console errors.
verified_behaviour.mobile_390: No horizontal overflow at 390px (documentElement.scrollWidth == innerWidth == 390). Reviews and FAQ sections both fit within viewport width.

critical_code_review_comments: seo.ts useSeo deps include the jsonLd array reference; on Home the array is defined at module scope (HOME_JSONLD = [faqJsonLd(faqs)]) so identity is stable and cleanup works correctly. If a future page inlines the array literal in the hook call, the effect will re-run every render and thrash the head. Consider useMemo/module-scope constants going forward.

Static index.html JSON-LD (CleaningService, WebSite) persists across route changes, which is fine, but the useSeo cleanup only removes scripts it created (dataset.seo='page'). Good separation – keep this invariant.
sitemap.xml lacks <lastmod> entries; not a bug, but adding lastmod improves crawl freshness signals.
Reviews are correctly labelled as demo and no aggregateRating/Review JSON-LD is emitted, aligning with the intent to avoid misleading structured data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3 verified reviews/FAQ/SEO+AEO on the public preview URL. Reviews component uses data-testid=reviews-section/reviews-average/review-card-r1..r9/reviews-demo-note; FAQ uses faq-section/faq-item-{i}/faq-toggle-{i}/faq-answer-{i}. useSeo cleans up only its own injected JSON-LD via dataset.seo='page'. Home injects FAQPage; /privat and /foretag inject Service+BreadcrumbList. Static CleaningService+WebSite live in index.html. robots.txt and sitemap.xml served from /app/frontend/public. No backend changes tested (per request).
